scope: Independent textual, retained-evidence and artifact-identity review of a prose-only manuscript revision; no new scientific or literature evaluation.

checks.detail: The revision centers the practical biomedical data gap, complete-cohort construction without individual inputs, evidence-to-joint-model authorship, and usefulness for specified scientific analyses.
The final Methods states that the Agent interprets supplied study definitions; researcher curation remains explicit. The resolved wording does not imply original-document extraction.

The A01 example is text-identical to v0.7 and agrees with the retained source-and-assumption trace. Separate adjusted projections, assumed residual correlation, derived joint coefficients, unit mapping and unfitted checks retain their meanings.

Four table bodies, all table captions, complete Results text and the worked-example/case/allocation/summary/HRS methodological blocks are text-identical to v0.7. No result selection or recalculation occurred.

Table3 still averages absolute seed discrepancies within an author and then across five Agent authors, not absolute discrepancy of the arm-average coefficient; unpaired condition authors remain explicit.

R receives 30 summaries plus uncertainty/design/quality metadata; its historical Pani packet remains distinct from main CHNS. Reconstruction, duplicate stages and absent additional revision gain are preserved.

HRS remains supplied-coefficient recipient-stage reconstruction: two constructions, six valid tables, nine attempts. Parser defect belongs to this implementation, its three failed comparator tables remain recorded, and Agent outputs were unchanged.

CHNS BMI worsening and conditional-age reversal, ENSANUT magnitude discrepancies, HRS weak upper interaction and narrow upper-HbA1c spread, historical tail defects and revision trade-offs all remain visible.

Reference uncertainty, conditional seed variation and HRS model-conditional intervals remain distinct. No first-in-field, universal quality, calibrated transport uncertainty, clinical substitution, measured labor saving or mandatory statistical-superiority claim is introduced.

A new research request may lead to a new model; the reusable procedure is not equated with one universal generator. Enrichment/direct-output support and unvalidated missing-cell completion remain separate.

Four main captions and image links plus all 11 bibliography entries are unchanged. Ten existing PNG/SVG assets match the retained figure-manifest bytes. All 26 local-link occurrences in draft/submission text resolve.
The v0.7 pinned reproduction package is explicitly retained for unchanged v0.8 displays. The new review verifies identity rather than repeating rendering/clinical checks or rebinding frozen inputs.

Author Summary and cover scientific paragraph agree with curated-input, analysis-specific construction/reconstruction scope. Availability, licensing and declarations remain unresolved preparation items, not claimed approvals.

Abstract is 227 whitespace words. Introduction states three concrete contributions; Discussion explains reconstruction's scientific-computing use and separates established algebra from the applied Agent procedure.

resolved_findings.finding: Preliminary wording could imply that the Agent independently recovered original statistic definitions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final wording explicitly says the Agent interprets supplied study definitions; original-article extraction remains curated.

limits: No independent re-extraction of original clinical literature or new mathematical/clinical validation.
Existing scientific audit reports were read; their numerical tests were not rerun.
Venue policy verification, author declarations, final journal-layout inspection and submission readiness are outside this review.
Public export may rewrite relative navigation links; this review binds the local manuscript bytes.
